items.name: voice-architecture
items.prompt: Create a polished widescreen editorial infographic ILLUSTRATION ASSET for a LIE presentation. Aspect ratio about 3:1 (wide strip), creamy ivory #FFFEF7 background. Use the same playful but sophisticated editorial art direction as reference: flat cream/lemon #FFF18A and cobalt #075BFA with deep navy #111B45 outlines, subtle tiny coral accents, crisp curves and bold visual hierarchy, generous whitespace. NO LOGO, NO TITLE, NO FOOTER, NO BODY PARAGRAPHS, NO METRICS. Only the specified short labels. This is a conceptual architecture diagram, not a product screenshot. Avoid generic rectangular boxes, stock corporate flowcharts and anonymous robot heads; turn semantic nodes into simple beautifully drawn editorial objects. Relationships must be unambiguous and exactly match the requested structure. Do not add extra nodes. DIAGRAM: bidirectional game voice architecture: a large browser window at left labelled '浏览器', connected by cobalt two-way path through a small narrow bridge in middle labelled '语音网关', connected to a navy speech bubble orb at right labelled '语音模型'. Inside browser window only three symbolic line rows representing data, no letters. Below browser a thin downward branch reaches a small folded document labelled '分享快照'; this branch must not connect to the voice model. Clear separation browser vs narrow gateway vs model. Large browser takes40% width; gateway20%, model25%. Use rounded contour perspective lightly, not 3D realism. Text exact, legible, minimal.
